document.title: Danas Piano Tutor — technical status
document.maintainer_note: Hand-maintained. Update 'status' when features change and append to 'changelog' for every change; the repository has no git history, so this file is the record.

product.name: Danas Piano Tutor
product.purpose: Scripted lessons for entry-level piano students: build a simple piece as text, listen at any speed with a metronome, see hand and finger positions, and print the sheet music.

entry_points.double_click: Danas Piano Tutor.bat (picks a Python 3.12+ that has PyQt6 and numpy; 3.14 on the development machine)
entry_points.from_raw: Help → Danas Piano Tutor… in the RAW main window
entry_points.browser: python tools/serve_web.py → http://127.0.0.1:8765 (or serve dist/ from any static host)
entry_points.listener: python tools/serve_web.py --listen → Danas Ear (microphone pitch listener); deployed at /listen/

recommended: sounddevice>=0.4 (playback; without it the cursor still moves)
not_used: scipy — voices are filter-free on purpose so pure-numpy rendering stays fast

status.overall: complete for the requested scope; 432/432 tests passing on 2026-09-20

features.feature: Lesson dialect of the raw.author JSON format (`lessons` list, per-hand note strings)
features.notes: Tokens: C4, C4:2, C4:1/8, C4:1.5, C4(3), [C3 E3 G3](5,3,1), rest `.`, hold `-`, bar `|`. Parallel `fingers` line. Bar-length check against the time signature.

features.feature: In-app Script tab with Apply (Ctrl+Enter), Tidy JSON, report pane, Save / Save As, New from template
Fingering inference from the five-finger hand position
features.notes: Written fingers move the position; unfingered notes under the hand get an inferred finger (grey on the score); notes outside are reported.

features.feature: Key signatures and note spelling
features.notes: Major and minor keys; in-key spelling, then the author's written accidental, then naturals, then the key's accidental family.

features.feature: Custom voices via `instruments` in the same document
Render through the RAW synth engine; tempo 25–150 % or absolute BPM
features.notes: Note lengths follow tempo musically (duration override), no resampling. Per-note render cache.

features.feature: Metronome with accented downbeat, count-in 0–2 bars
Hands selector (both / right / left), muted hand dimmed in every view
Practice loop over a bar range; click a bar to jump; count-in plays once per loop start
Click a key on the on-screen keyboard to hear it
Keyboard coloured per hand with finger numbers on keys; resting position tinted before play
Hand diagram: playing finger lit, next finger outlined, note names at fingertips, position text
Lesson panel: key, time, tempo, bars, voice, hand positions, instructions, tips, script warnings
Engraved grand staff on screen with cursor and highlighted sounding notes
features.notes: Clefs, key and time signatures, noteheads, stems, flags, dots, ledger lines, accidentals per measure, ties (also across systems), rests and whole-measure rests, fingering above (RH) and below (LH), bar numbers, Ctrl+wheel zoom.

known_limitations: No beams: eighth and sixteenth notes are drawn with flags.
Up to two voices per hand are engraved with stems; extra voices are dropped with a warning.
No triplets, grace notes, dynamics, slurs, pedal or repeat signs.
One hand position model (five white keys); black-key positions are not modelled.
Clef and rest glyphs come from the system font (Segoe UI Symbol on Windows); other platforms fall back to drawn shapes.
The `.py` file association on the development machine points at Python 3.1 — use the .bat or `py -3.14`.

architecture.principle: A lesson is data on a division grid (8 per quarter). Audio, keyboard, hands, score, PDF and MusicXML are all derived from that one model; nothing is stored twice.

changelog.summary: Piano Tutor built on top of RAW
changes: Lesson model on the DIVISIONS grid with hands, fingers, key/time signature, positions, tips (raw/teach/score.py).
Lesson scripting dialect parser with chords, finger suffixes, parallel fingers line, bar checks, path-labelled warnings (raw/teach/authoring.py).
Fingering inference from five-finger positions; written fingers move the position.
Built-in voices piano / music_box / organ / chip and metronome clicks (raw/teach/voice.py).
Lesson renderer with tempo, hands, metronome, count-in, bar range and note cache (raw/teach/player.py).
Grand-staff engraver (raw/teach/engrave.py) and QPainter renderer shared by screen and print.
MusicXML export with fingering, fixed staves per hand, key signature and composer; raw/export/sheet.py extended, chunker shared with the engraver.
Main window: transport (play/stop, tempo slider + BPM, hands, metronome, count-in, loop range), score view, note lane, keyboard with finger discs, hand diagram, lesson panel, script tab.
Export PDF, Print, Export MusicXML, Export WAV.
Seven example lesson files; docs/LESSON_FORMAT.md; README and TECHNICAL.md sections; tests/test_teach.py.

changelog.summary: Engraving corrections found while reviewing renders
changes: Clefs fitted by measured glyph ink so they sit on the staff regardless of font metrics; clef allowance widened.
Bass-clef key-signature positions corrected (same staff lines as treble, one step lower).
Finger stacks for chords ordered like the notes (lowest note nearest the staff for RH, highest nearest for LH).
Bar numbers moved to the system's left edge above the staff.
Inferred fingering no longer repeated on an immediately repeated note (less clutter, like method books).
Dots placed by the on-line flag from the engraver instead of a y-parity guess.
Note.alter records a sharp/flat the author typed; score.spell() honours it after the key's own spelling, then prefers naturals (F5 in G major is no longer spelled E#).
Spellings threaded through engraving and MusicXML (build_musicxml(spellings=…)).

changelog.summary: Hand diagram thumbs angled outward toward the fingers; default mix gain −12 dB so six-note stacks never trigger normalisation.
Danas Piano Tutor name and splash screen
changes: App renamed Danas Piano Tutor (raw/teach/__init__.py: __version__ 1.0.0, APP_NAME, TAGLINE); window title, About and RAW Help menu updated.

Splash screen (raw/ui/teach/splash.py) with assets/tutor_splash.jpg centre-cropped (FOCUS_Y 0.44, 720×590), version/date/engine top-right, name and tagline on black; auto-closes after 4.5 s or on click; Help → Splash Screen.
Printed PDF now ends with Instructions, Hand positions and Tips.

changelog.summary: App would not launch by double-click
changes: Cause: the .py file association points at C:\Python31 (Python 3.1, 2010); only Python 3.14 has PyQt6/numpy/sounddevice installed.

teach.py rewritten to run from any working directory, check interpreter version and packages, and show a Windows message box with the fix instead of a traceback (kept Python-3.1-parseable so the message actually appears).
Added 'Danas Piano Tutor.bat': double-click launcher that tries py -3.14/-3.13/-3.12 then python, and pauses on error.

changelog.summary: Moving hands on the keyboard and hand span
changes: web/src/palms.js: per-hand placement timeline (anchor = key of the note minus the finger's offset), nearest-finger choice for unfingered notes, smooth glide over the beat before a shift, pressed fingers from sounding notes.

Keyboard draws two palms with five fingers over the keys; pressing fingers reach onto the key (further for black keys) and carry the finger number; muted hand drawn dim. Key finger discs are hidden while palms are shown.
Lesson key `span` (5–8): raw/teach/score.py finger_offsets spreads resting keys; inference, hand_position and web summary use it; authoring parses, clamps with warnings and round-trips it.
Settings: switch show.palms; 'Hand span' override (remembered in the browser). Keyboard row 150 px.
docs/LESSON_FORMAT.md documents span; 3 new tests (439).
